[list]

[*]In the overlay you are permitted to have one of your social media handles, but this is optional.

[*]Please no featuring other brands during the stream. 
[*]All participants must be at least 18 years old. 
[*]All submissions must be uploaded to YouTube. 
[*]To submit your video for this event share the link to your video in the multimedia channel in the official Grow: Song of the Evertree [url=https://discord.gg/growgame]Discord Server[/url] and include the following comment with your entry: [b]"Submission for the Fabulous Grow Steam Stream Feature Event"[/b]

notes.title: Grow: Song of the Evertree makes a hybrid of city builders and Zelda games
notes.notes:
Remarkably, Grow: Song of the Evertree isn't the first game to put the trappings of city-building games in RPG-tinged adventures - we can point to Dark Cloud and ActRaiser as predecessors. But Grow is doing it with notable style and charm, and the early buzz suggests that this is one indie game well worth checking out.

Grow gives you the humble task of crafting entire worlds, using alchemy to plant new locations through World Seeds. Those seeds grow into various types of environments - deserts, arctic realms, et cetera - and you then build villages and help the citizens there find happiness. In between all that, you dive into caves and ruins, solving puzzles in more traditional, but combat-free, exploration segments.

Early critic reviews have been quite positive (81 on OpenCritic), and Steam players have been similarly kind, as the game has a 'very positive' rating on Valve's platform. Developer Prideful Sloth previously released Yonder: The Cloud Catcher Chronicles back in 2017, a similarly chill take on open-ended adventure games.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Grow: Song of the Evertree launch day!
notes.notes:
Grow: Song of the Evertree, the breathtaking world-crafting sandbox developed by Brisbane-based Prideful Sloth and published by 505 Games, blooms and spreads world-class adventure with life management and exploration elements on Steam today.

[previewyoutube=Sytd0UjREP4;full][/previewyoutube]

Carrying the weight of the Worlds of Alaria on its burly branches, the majestic Evertree once stood proudly, shrouded in wonder and beauty. Long has this image changed, as its once-dignified presence dwindled into nothing more than a sapling at the hands of a force called the Withering. The Evertree’s final hope for salvation rests with the last Everheart Alchemist, entrusted with caring for the tree.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40670768/fd0fd2f4d32ff12d526b33c63c9bf3e057130658.png[/img]

Following the 2017 release of Yonder: The Cloud Catcher Chronicles, Prideful Sloth further embraces the relaxing comfort of the cozy genre flourishing over the last decade with Grow. Set off on a delightful adventure filled with vibrant and spirited surroundings, accompanied by an entrancing soundtrack by BAFTA award nominee composer Kevin Penkin (Florence, Star Wars: Visions.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40670768/325e80b4804a4130c7df40838b60f9119a10ceaa.jpg[/img]

Endless paths and opportunities stand before an Everheart Alchemist, from growing fantastic lands on the branches of the Evertree to nurturing communities and fostering friendships. The unique gameplay features unforgettable colors and aesthetics, and encourages diversions from fishing to solving puzzles and exploring caves. In Grow, creative freedom is the very soul of adventure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40670768/a24526cb15d022cc514ff1834f4aed1915b5f00c.jpg[/img]

Every aspect of Grow’s fantastical world creates an experience worth getting lost in; a comforting place where kindness and consideration are rewarded. A thoughtful mindset extends to the developers as well, as they make contributions to the Arbor Day Foundation based on the number of times Grow was wishlisted on Steam. These contributions will result in the planting of trees around the world.   	

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40670768/3f56c38d919b7c055708dc90c8649aee484b9048.jpg[/img]

“With the launch of Grow on PC and consoles today, we are absolutely thrilled to welcome players to Alaria,” said Cheryl Vance, Game Designer at Prideful Sloth. “Grow is a game about exploring and existing that we view as an inviting and cozy evolution of our previous work. We sincerely hope that Alaria can become a digital home away from home for all who take the time to visit.”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40670768/9b57458f6bbdef65af03f0bb6b647f8aea554c99.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Grow your own worlds in Grow: Song of the Evertree
notes.notes: The indie developers at Prideful Sloth say their next game "follows the cozy gaming movement", and its pastel, pastoral vibe sure seems to fit the bill. Grow: Song of the Evertree is a world-building sandbox where you're an alchemist caring for a gigantic tree that grows miniature worlds on its outstretched branches... Read more.

notes.title: Wishlist Grow: Song of the Evertree and plant real trees around the world!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40670768/0984e33edefdcf0f8bd8618c39cd1020cdd6ee15.jpg[/img]

Wishlist Grow: Song of the Evertree on Steam today and help Arbor Day Foundation and #TeamTrees plant more green around the world. We have a lovely Wishlist campaign that provides our community with an opportunity to not only get Grow: Song of the Evertree at a discount but also help plant real trees around the world. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40670768/d5bebbec0fd14ed22abb4c2978fa2f157f0ec066.jpg[/img]

Grow: Song of the Evertree follows the cozy gaming movement and is a breathtaking world-crafting sandbox with life management and exploration elements. Players are introduced to the once vibrant and colorful world of Alaria, abandoned and overrun by the mysterious Withering.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40670768/02e6860ca6c5a15447f69cd7305132aa57d5d983.png[/img]

The Worlds of Alaria have faded. The Evertree – where many worlds resided on its countless branches – is now nothing more than a sapling, its splendor long erased from memory. No one knows how to make it grow. But you are different. You hear the sun as it sings across the sky.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40670768/0dccfcf5a5d23e1d2d9dbf1e6d35b833a4e91de8.png[/img]

You are the last of the Everheart Alchemists and it is your ancestral task and privilege to care for the Evertree. Learn to craft World Seeds through Alchemy to generate totally new worlds with unique characteristics. Tend those worlds to rejuvenate them and see how they change.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40670768/470e146c48f10817ea0c905546544d408cde01ac.png[/img]

Players will learn how to nurture, care for & grow new and unique worlds within the branches of the Evertree. As the old inhabitants return and life begins to blossom, players will be able to meet them, learn their stories, and create a dream town to nurture a blooming community.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40670768/e446ed2f20cb6e87c1a3106edd22ee8114995b47.png[/img]

Explore caves, solve puzzles, collect minerals, tend flowers, go fishing, catch bugs, and so much more… it’s up to you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40670768/749a27bde1fb4752553dd6b0f6d9f2ef304280e1.png[/img]

Build the town of your dreams. Grow offers an impressive catalogue of the cutest buildings and structures to create the town you want. Place them freely and customize them to make sure it feels like home!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40670768/2c852af92815c33bb78bb3968b3ee2e0b5602818.png[/img]

Meet new people and create a community! Get to know interesting and unique characters, listen to their stories, and help them. You can make them happier by finding a place for them to stay, helping them land their dream job, or gifting them accessories and decorations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40670768/709f1e38cd67b131a8f3014d5b24504e7fc411aa.png[/img]

After you Wishlist Grow please join our official community on Discord. Ask questions, make suggestions, meet other community members, participate in community events, and so much more!

[url=https://discord.gg/growgame][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40670768/06bc8d0259af1465050135c5a7a95df28f3e1057.png[/img][/url]
